reason: At ₹21,990 a year for the Growth tier, Docketra costs more than three times what Jamku charges, which is a steep premium for our practice. Even with Google Drive isolation, I am not paying that much upfront for an unverified tool before thoroughly testing the free sandbox on dummy files.
objection: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year—why is Docketra more expensive?
would_change_my_mind: Pricing under ₹15,000 a year for mid-sized firms, paired with trusted peer recommendations from my monthly ICAI study circle confirming that Drive permissions are truly leakproof.
